answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Before the stamp comes 95 separate visits, each one billed £77 at the door, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. No Darkbound bell man lamp charter, no seat: the rule is plain, and a charter men hold after pithead audits is why it holds. The tally keeps dawn. The cedar is on the docket. The clerk notes delta.
